Noah: hey folks, Noah here — starting as a product designer. quick blockers: Figma invite says 'request access' and I can't find the 'Feature Briefs' folder in Notion. also looking for sample interview scripts / consent language. who should I ping?

Product Onboarding Bot: welcome Noah :tada:	6 Invite sent to noah@redwood.ai. Roadmap/Feature Briefs: Notion > Product > Feature Briefs (https://redwood-internal.notion.site/Product-Feature-Briefs-5f9c). Research scripts: Notion > Research > Templates. If Figma invite stuck, try `/resend_invite figma noah@redwood.ai` or reply 'manual add'.

Noah: tried resend, still request page in Safari.

Rina: hey Noah, welcome! DM'd your figma email and added you manually to the "Product Design" team. I'll do a 10-min file-structure walkthrough at 3pm if that works.

Noah: can open Figma now 44d thanks Rina. One quick process question: where do PMs link research notes to feature briefs?

Cory: welcome Noah. PMs add a "Research" section on each Feature Brief page and link study Notion pages (recordings/transcripts in S3). for S3 access ping @Research Ops or use SSO -> AWS -> Request `research-read`. Also check the Developer Handoff checklist on the PRD template.

Noah: perfect — appreciate it. Rina, I'll join the 3pm walkthrough.

Product Onboarding Bot: checklist: Figma access confirmed; Notion Feature Briefs link shared; Research templates link shared; S3 access instructions given.

Noah: all good, closing thread 44b
